svg.title: D-FINE-S + AQS - compact reference flow
svg.desc: Compact reference-style overview. Original D-FINE Hybrid Encoder and Top300 query initialization are retained. AQS refines query content after decoder layer 2 and before layer 3. Fusion containers summarize three scale states, not the number of executable fusion operators. Classroom images and colored output links are schematic, not measured predictions.
